title: Naive obstruction theories give quasi-isomorphisms on fibres
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Let z = x over k; (RS*) identifies Lift(x, A[k]) = Lift(z, k[k]) = Lift(y, B[k]) since A[k] = A x_k k[k] and B[k] = B x_k k[k]; the naive obstruction theory properties then force the functoriality map to induce bijections Ext^i_A(E_x, k) -> Ext^i_B(E_y, k) for i = -1, 0; by the Ext-into-field computation these are duals of the maps H^i(E_x (L) k) -> H^i(E_y (L) k), which are therefore isomorphisms for i = 0, 1.
